name: measureUserAgentSpecificMemory()
plain: Asks for a breakdown of memory the page and its iframes use.
meaning: Reports total bytes and per-origin attribution in cross-origin isolated contexts. A noisy but accurate measure of memory use, useful for leaks and for inferring device memory pressure.

steps: Call the method (takes 0 to 20 s, GC-aligned)

limits.headline: Can check how much memory the page and its embeds use
limits.user_action: Nothing. The site calls it while the page is open, in a protected page mode
can: Get the total memory the page uses
Get a split by source, only in cross origin isolated pages
Guess your device's memory size from the numbers
cannot: Get these numbers outside protected pages
limits.differs: Chrome and Edge only. Firefox and Safari do not support it.

story.what_it_is: A page can ask for a breakdown of how much memory it and its frames use.

marketing.name: Monitor total page memory usage
marketing.pitch: Google says it lets sites measure memory across the whole page, to find leaks and bloat.

story.for_you: You never see it. It helps teams find pages that hog memory and crash tabs. Fixed pages stay faster and your browser is less likely to say Aw, Snap.
story.for_makers: Real time apps and long sessions can leak memory until the tab crashes. This API lets teams measure it from real visitors, but it only works on isolated pages, because it could leak data between sites.

use_cases.example: A browser game studio sees tabs crash after 30 minutes and finds a memory leak in a texture loader.
A video call site tracks memory over a long meeting and fixes a leak that crashed older laptops.
A design tool checks memory growth on large files to decide when to warn you to save.
A big web spreadsheet checks memory use in test runs to keep huge sheets from freezing.
A QA team runs automated tests that fail a build if memory grows too much.
Monitoring tools collect page memory and show which release made it worse.
A retailer finds that an endless scroll product list uses too much memory on cheap phones.

technical_bounds: Result delayed and noised to prevent Spectre-style use

history.change: Origin trial replaces performance.memory for precise use
